strategies.label: WARP Tunnel (Standard)
strategies.hint: Traffic flows through Cloudflare WARP to hide the proxy from your ISP.

strategies.label: Vwarp (Masque Obfuscation)
strategies.hint: WARP chain with Vwarp MASQUE metadata for deployments that use vwarp obfuscation presets.

strategies.label: Vwarp (AtomicNoize)
strategies.hint: WARP chain with Vwarp AtomicNoize metadata for fragmentation-style evasion outside sing-box native outputs.

strategies.label: Double WARP (WARP-in-WARP)
strategies.hint: Double encapsulation: outer WARP wraps inner WARP wraps your proxy. Maximum obfuscation.

strategies.label: WARP + Psiphon (change exit location)
strategies.hint: WARP + Psiphon: uses vwarp's --cfon to change the WARP exit country. Requires the vwarp binary.

strategies.label: Relay Chain (multi-hop, any protocol)
strategies.hint: Up to 4 intermediate hops of any protocol (SOCKS5, HTTP, VLESS, VMess, Trojan, SS, WARP). Use local proxies, LAN relays, or pipeline proxies.

strategies.label: TLS Fragment (legacy/manual)
strategies.hint: Legacy/manual TLS fragmentation recipe. Native sing-box tls_fragment output is disabled; use Vwarp AtomicNoize when available.

strategies.label: CDN Worker Relay
strategies.hint: Routes traffic through your own Cloudflare Worker. This may improve availability on some networks.

strategies.label: Custom Sing-box JSON
strategies.hint: Define your own outbound chain in raw Sing-box JSON format.
